historical_references.reference: Shahjahan was the fifth son of Emperor Jahangir and Mumtaz Mahal. He succeeded his father in 1628, and ruled until his death in 1658. During his reign, he completed the Taj Mahal in Agra as a mausoleum for his wife Mumtaz Mahal, who died during childbirth in 1631.

Shahjahan is also known for his architectural achievements, including the Red Fort in Delhi, the Taj Mahal in Agra, and the Jama Masjid in Delhi. He also ordered the construction of the Peacock Throne, which was a renowned symbol of Mughal power.
